# Shuush

> Open-source local GPU voice dictation, 5-source screen context, anti-paraphrase LLM cleanup, and native GTK4 Studio for Linux and Wayland — built cleanly on top of MIT-licensed voxtype.

Shuush is a free, MIT-licensed desktop intelligence layer for Arch Linux, Omarchy, Hyprland, Sway, and Niri. It sits on top of stock `voxtype-bin` (zero fork drift) across NVIDIA CUDA, AMD ROCm/Vulkan, Intel Vulkan, and CPU backends. Measured across 333 real coding and chat dictations (19,498 words, ~8.1 hours saved vs 40 WPM typing) on an Intel i5-13450HX + RTX 4050 Laptop 6 GB: ~2.3 GB resident CUDA VRAM (Parakeet Unified EN 0.6B fp16), 516 ms P50 / 1,060 ms P90 end-to-end cleanup latency (24 ms when already clean), and 98.8% cleanup reliability.

## Documentation & Essays

- [Shuush Home & Benchmarks](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/): Interactive hotkey demo, 333-take hardware telemetry, Wispr Flow and Superwhisper comparison, GTK4 Studio preview, and 3-step installation.
- [Writing Index](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/): Filterable archive of Shuush engineering notes, benchmarks, and Wayland dictation guides.
- [Why We Built Shuush](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/why-we-built-shuush/): Architecture overview, 5-source bounded context design, real-world laptop benchmarks, and zero-fork separation from voxtype.
- [Adding Local Ollama, Groq & Screen Context Post-Processing to Voxtype (v1.3+)](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/voxtype-post-process-ollama-groq-screen-context/): Complete zero-ambiguity guide to `[output.post_process]`, `shuush wire-config`, air-gapped Ollama vs Groq failover, and `voxtype v1.3+` upgrade compatibility.
- [Why Raw LLM Dictation Cleanup Fails (Anti-Paraphrase Span Gate)](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/anti-paraphrase-span-gate/): How `voxtype_pp_gate.py` prevents silent LLM rewrites and how `voxtype_learn.py` prevents ordinary-English dictionary poisoning.
- [Replacing Superwhisper's 10k Word Cap on Omarchy & Hyprland](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/blog/omarchy-hyprland-superwhisper-alternative/): Step-by-step zero-fork setup guide for Arch, Omarchy, Hyprland, Sway, and Niri with air-gapped Ollama or cloud failover.

## Install & Diagnostics

- [1-Line Installer Script](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/install.sh): Safe, idempotent bash installer for Shuush CLI, GTK4 Studio, KitsuneHud Quickshell pill, systemd user units, and backed-up `config.toml` wiring.
- [Pre-Flight Health Doctor](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/doctor.sh): Standalone diagnostic script checking Wayland, voxtype, GPU acceleration, wl-clipboard, wtype, GTK4/Libadwaita, AT-SPI, and Quickshell.

## Optional

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/KitsuneKode/shuush): Full MIT source code, sandbox test suite, Hyprland binds, and issue tracker.
- [Upstream voxtype](https://github.com/peteonrails/voxtype): Peter Jackson's MIT local speech-to-text daemon that powers Shuush's audio capture, GPU ASR inference, and Wayland typing.
- [RSS Feed](https://shuush.kitsunekode.in/rss.xml): Atom/RSS feed for new engineering essays.
